source.title: BC Railway Company, Statement of Financial Information, fiscal year ended March 31, 2024

summary: Two wordmarks from the Company's 2024 Statement of Financial Information, in a supplied package: the cover's, rebuilt in Eurostile Demi outlines fitted to its 600 × 327 JPEG, and the letterhead's, its own Verdana Bold Italic glyph outlines extracted from page 3. Both are distinct from the heavier wordmark on the Company's website. See package-README.md and review/comparison.webp.

assets.sourceFile: Statement of Financial Information, fiscal year ended March 31, 2024
assets.dateNote: The report's fiscal year, not an adoption date.
assets.label: BC Railway Company — Cover wordmark, 2024 report (reconstruction)
assets.sourceLocator: PDF page 1 (repeated on page 36), a 600 × 327 JPEG
assets.notes: The four words stepped down to the right, each initial in red and the rest in purple-blue, in a wide oblique Eurostile — the BCRC acrostic, as the 2024 report's cover sets it.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied reconstruction: genuine Eurostile Demi outlines with one shared widening (about 131%) and slant (about 15.4°), the red initials about 122% of the blue, each letter placed to the cover image (silhouette overlap 0.97). The cover is a JPEG, so the typeface is a match, not a recovery. Red #E63C2B and purple-blue #3A3376 are sampled from it.

assets.sourceFile: Statement of Financial Information, fiscal year ended March 31, 2024
assets.dateNote: The report's fiscal year, not an adoption date.
assets.label: BC Railway Company — Letterhead wordmark, 2024 report
assets.sourceLocator: PDF page 3, the management letter's heading
assets.notes: The same stepped acrostic in Verdana Bold Italic, red initials and blue letters, at the head of the management letter. The final C of COMPANY is set larger than the other initials, as printed.
assets.fidelityNote: The page's own lettering: the embedded Verdana Bold Italic glyph outlines at their printed sizes (11.04 pt, initials 12.96 pt, the last C 14.04 pt) and positions, converted to paths. Colours are the PDF's own (#FF0000, #0000FF).
